context_note: Incremental rate above no-cover-crop control (C = 0.09 Mg ha-1 yr-1); NL rate = 0.17 minus 0.09 = 0.08. Averaged over both tillage systems and all four N fertilization rates. This correctly isolates the cover crop effect.
Incremental rate above no-cover-crop control (C = 0.09); LNL rate = 0.41 minus 0.09 = 0.32. Averaged over tillage and N fertilization. Correctly isolates the legume cover crop effect.
Incremental rate above no-cover-crop control (C = 0.09); HNL rate = 0.43 minus 0.09 = 0.34. Averaged over tillage and N fertilization. Correctly isolates the high-N legume cover crop effect.

Absolute SOC change rate in NL systems from 1993 baseline, averaged over both tillage systems and all four N fertilization rates. This is NOT the isolated cover crop effect (which is 0.08, captured in E1); it includes tillage and N effects. The extractor correctly labels this as 'absolute' vs. initial 1993 SOC. Synthesis should not use this value as the cover-crop-only increment.

Absolute SOC change rate in LNL systems from 1993 baseline, averaged over tillage and N treatments. Not the isolated cover crop effect (which is 0.32, captured in E2). Synthesis should distinguish from the incremental effect reported in E2.

Absolute SOC change rate in HNL systems from 1993 baseline, averaged over tillage and N treatments. Not the isolated cover crop effect (which is 0.34, captured in E3). Synthesis should distinguish from the incremental effect reported in E3.
